lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign and choose_path layout) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 tests (rounds 1 and 7).
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 4 tests.
Adoption layout (3 tests) and choose_path redesign (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes showed no clear effect or hurt performance across 2 tests.

Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, choose_path copy, finish layout, finish copy, finish redesign, home notification, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption new_screen (fewer than 2 agreeing tests).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection step with a compact grid layout featuring choice card components for quicker character selection.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in the onboarding funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89 seconds.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet archetype to bring to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen with compact choice cards retains the ability to choose a pet and stays within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (60.9%), but past adoption redesigns yielded -1.4% lift.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Fast Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Add an instant pet avatar selection flow within photo upload to allow users to skip photo rendering issues.
candidates.why: Custom pet rendering fails or creates wrong results for multiple users (3 support tickets), causing adoption drop-off.

upload_photos.headline: Create or Pick Your Pet Avatar
upload_photos.body: Upload a custom pet photo or select one of our curated pet templates.

guard.reason: Adding preset pet template choices alongside photo upload within the photo upload screen does not skip or remove any required onboarding step.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses 3 support tickets on adoption failure, but new flow implementation carries risk.

candidates.title: Story Screen Initial Path Order Adjustment
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding sequence so users choose their companion path immediately before reading the welcome story.
candidates.why: Choose path takes 8s median but mean time reaches 514s; starting with path choice builds quick momentum.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey
story.body: Discover how your pet lives, plays, and assists right on your screen.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut & Docking Setup Screen
candidates.change: Add a new setup screen before completion explaining desktop placement, pet hiding, and screen docking shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 tickets) report confusion about controlling, hiding, or finding the pet on the desktop.

new_desktop_setup.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
new_desktop_setup.body: Learn how to move, hide, or talk to your companion from your desktop bar.

guard.reason: Adding a new setup screen explaining desktop controls before home intro is allowed under Rule 4 as a new onboarding screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 3 support tickets, but adding new screens at finish step historically hurt performance (-1.1%).

candidates.title: Account Recovery Security Headline Copy Update
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen headline and hint text to emphasize automatic pet data protection and cloud saving.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet & Sync Data
sign_in.body: Linking your account ensures your pet's traits, items, and memory are backed up safely.
sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet across app updates and device changes.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to highlight account sync and backup keeps the sign-in step intact and violates no rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 tickets) combined with high confidence from sign_in copy/hint wins.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Entry Hint Safeguard
candidates.change: Display a helpful hint and companion mascot badge explaining that pet names can be changed anytime later.
candidates.why: Adoption takes median 89s with 60.9% drop-off as users overthink official companion details.

adoption_certificate.hint: Don't worry! You can update your pet's name and details anytime in app settings.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful hint and mascot component to the adoption certificate screen preserves the step and its functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (60.9%, 89s median) with low-cost hint pattern that proved successful previously.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Sound & Alert
candidates.change: Add an optional readiness chime and notification badge on the waiting screen when desktop pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home wait step has high mean duration (2336s) and users complain about pet not appearing on desktop.

waiting.hint: We will play a sound and alert you when your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding audio chimes and readiness alerts to the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait complaints; home notifications previously delivered +0.9% lift across 3 tests.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Animation Companion Display
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot preview and step counter to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s; visual feedback reduces perceived waiting time.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and animated previews to the waiting screen maintains its core job of showing the pet being created.

candidates.score_note: Targets long home wait times, but 4 past wait_info tests showed no clear effect (+0.5%).

candidates.title: Split Screen Story Welcome Layout
candidates.change: Change the welcome story screen to a split layout with pet illustration side-by-side with welcome text.
candidates.why: Choose path step has 81% conversion; improving entry appeal sets clearer expectations upfront.

story.headline: Meet Your New Screen Companion
story.body: Your pet lives right on your computer desktop, reacting to your day and keeping you company.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen to a split layout with pet illustrations properly introduces the pet and keeps the step.

candidates.score_note: Targets 81% step; single previous layout test showed +5.1% lift, though evidence remains thin.

candidates.title: First Day Desktop Pet Reward Checklist
candidates.change: Add a starter reward checklist component on the home intro screen incentivizing initial pet interactions.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 68% and users express confusion about post-setup pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! 3 Quick Things to Try
home_intro.body: Complete your first interactions to claim your companion starter badge.

components.text: 1. Drag pet to your favorite screen corner
2. Double click pet to give a treat

guard.reason: Adding an introductory interaction checklist on the home intro screen stays within onboarding and adheres to fair design.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 68% finish drop-off and post-setup confusion with active onboarding incentive.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high overall, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign and choose_path layout) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 tests (rounds 1 and 7).
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 4 tests.
Adoption layout (3 tests), choose_path redesign (2 tests), and finish redesign (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance.

Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish layout, finish copy, home notification, sign_in copy, and sign_in redesign.
